notes.title: 2024 In review & What's coming in 2025
notes.content:
Greetings, Operators,
As 2025 approaches, we want to take this Dev Update #5 as an opportunity to look back at what we achieved together in 2024 and share some insights into our plans for 2025. Spoiler: the community will be even more involved!

[h2]600,000 WISHLISTS[/h2]
We recently reached 600,000 wishlists on Steam, exceeding even our highest objective. Huge thanks to everyone for your support, enthusiasm, and for spreading the word about Beautiful Light!

[h2]2024 REWIND[/h2]
[list]
This year, each month has been rich in content and improvements, but we've selected a few highlights for each of them:
[*] January - We kicked off 2024 with the first community playtests of the year, built on what we've made in 2023 and testing performance across more configurations.
[*] February - The first iteration of the Skin Forge was introduced, finally allowing character customization!
[*] March - We developed AtmoStorm, our dynamic weather system that simulates realistic weather conditions based on real sun position data. Ligthing and colors are then handcrafted to create -beautiful- weather scenarios.
[*] April - Major optimization work was done, and we launched the [url=https://deepworlds.studio/dev-timeline]Development Timeline[/url], giving you near real-time insights on our progress.
[*] May - [url=https://x.com/BeautifulLght/status/1778033638124175755]PC Gamer tested Beautiful Light[/url]! We also hit 25,000 members on Discord.
[*] June - We reworked the movement component system, improving both workflow efficiency and game performance. You can find the open-source code [url=https://github.com/DeepWorldsSA/DeepWorlds_GMCAbilitySystem]here[/url]. Also, we introduced the Boom Ball!
[*] July - The first playable anomaly, The Juggernaut, was implemented!
[*] August - We reached 500,000 wishlists!
[*] September - We compiled the most frequently asked questions into an [url=https://deepworlds.studio/BL-FAQ]Extended FAQ[/url], covering various aspects of the game.
[*] October - Our biggest playtest session yet took place, involving over 250 Discord community members, along with a few content creators.
[*] November - Playtests provided valuable insights on balance, bugs, and design improvements.
[*] December - Check out the video below! (oh, and we're now 37k members on [url=https://discord.gg/project-bl]Discord[/url] !)
[/list]

[h2]DEV UPDATE PRESENTED BY [b]Psychoghost[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=Y8Kwz7EVNOo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]PREVIOUS DEV UPDATE :[/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DrksuiBkbLI

[h1]What's coming in 2025[/h1]
[list]
[*] 2025 will be a community driven and important year for Beautiful Light. We will be conducting the first medium- and large-scale playtests on Steam to test the robustness of our matchmaking system, servers, and backend. 
[*] Additionally, we will be working on persistent economy systems, including inventory and stash management. Gear fear basically! 
[*] We aim to begin playtesting the second map as soon as possible to validate early gameplay elements for its gameloop. This map will build upon Ground Zero, offering even higher-stakes gameplay. Here, you can bring in a previously extracted artifact to increase its value. It's all or nothing. 
[*] Later in the year, likely in Q4, we will also implement the first progression systems for PMCs and anomalies.
[/list]

We can't wait for you to get your hands on the results of our hard work!

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #4
notes.content:
Greetings, Operators,
In Dev Update 4, you’ll see some of the things we’ve worked on between July and October.

One of the highlights is the introduction of the PDA, the Personal Digital Assistant. This device on the forearm of the player will be the main source of information. You'll be able to access details related to the game mode, friends, your health status, world events, and navigation around the map. The Sheitan, a new PvE anomaly designed to surprise players, is now in its animation phase and will soon be implemented in the game. We’ve also refined gun animations and introduced point aiming, a middle ground between hipfire and ADS.

Check out the full details in the video below!
